rdfs:label: view
rdfs:comment: Links a resource or RDF class to an ES module URL that renders it — the SolidOS data-browser pane convention.
notes: Pane-discovery convention used by SolidOS / mashlib / LOSOS data browsers: a subject (resource or rdfs:Class) `view`s an ES module URL whose default export renders the subject. Lowercase property — distinct from `urn:solid:View` (the ActivityStreams 2.0 View activity class). Upstream range is `xsd:anyURI` (a literal), as in the example; IRI-node objects are also seen in practice and should be accepted. The upstream solidos vocabulary marks this term unstable upstream (term_status 'unstable').

examples.title: Register a renderer module for a class

history.note: Example pairs tracker-pane.js with wf:Tracker and uses an xsd:anyURI literal per upstream range; notes flag the term as unstable upstream.
